card.name: Scattered words in technical citations
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered punctuation and small words in science citations and on linking words in drug-interaction or pharmacokinetic sentences.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Colon, quote mark or period in a journal citation title.
modes.example: C. L. Bennett et al., "First-Year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe (WMAP) Observations<<:>> Preliminary Maps and Basic Results," Astroph

modes.label: Linking words in interaction text
modes.description: Small words such as the, been, was or % inside drug-effect sentences.
modes.example: YP3A4 substrate triazolam (single dose of 0.25 mg) did not significantly affect<< the>> pharmacokinetics of either citalop
